Class BitAddress

java.lang.Object
org.roux.model.BitAddress
public class BitAddress extends Object
The BitAddress is a view of one range inside a page. The object stores the region id. The object stores the page id. The object stores the byte offset of that range. The object stores a bit offset inside the first byte. The object stores the length of the span in bits. The payload bytes stay on the page. This object does not copy those bytes. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#BitAddress roux-design.md

  • Constructor Details

    • BitAddress

      public BitAddress(String regionId, int pageId, long byteOffset, int bitOffsetWithinByte, long bitLength)
      The constructor stores the region, the page, the byte offset, the bit offset, and the bit length.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the name of the region.
      pageId - The page id is the number of the page.
      byteOffset - The byte offset is the start of the range in the page.
      bitOffsetWithinByte - The bit offset is the bit inside that first byte.
      bitLength - The bit length is the number of bits in the span.
